title: Martyrdom, Satnam, and the Unity of Guru and Sikh

blocks.text: This page develops a theology of witness by insisting that Guru and Sikh cannot be separated. Martyrs accept the Guru's word as life itself, so their steadfastness is presented as proof that Panthic courage comes from grace and not from empty bravado.

The fragment then shifts into confrontation with political authority. Demands for submission or conversion are answered with calm refusal, because the Khalsa understands its true command as already received from the Guru.

In the final movement, even a child is imagined answering the challenge with Sikh certainty. The genuine kalma here is rendered through Satnam and Vahiguru, making verbal confession itself an act of unbroken allegiance.
